context: A daily standup that contains only progress reports - checks that the actions-to-issues skill behaves as its policy says.

checklist.name: proposes_no_cards
checklist.description: The result contains zero approval cards and its RESULT line reports `meetings=1` and `cards=0`.

checklist.name: recognises_progress_not_work
checklist.description: The result explains, briefly, that the items are progress on existing work (finish / continue / still on), not new work.

checklist.name: ends_with_result_line
checklist.description: The result ends with exactly one RESULT: line.

checklist.name: no_write_calls
checklist.description: result.md contains no `CALL linear_save_issue` or `CALL linear_save_comment` line.
